## Objective
- Build "CALL OF ZOMBIES: ROUND WAR" — a complete, playable round-based zombie survival FPS in one self-contained HTML file (no dependencies), including Xbox controller support with Call of Duty Zombies controller presets.
- Original request: "Add xbox controller support with call of duty zombie controller presets" for a then-empty repo; the large spec for ROUND WAR followed and supersedes the earlier smaller demo.

## Requirements
- From spec: playable FPS movement, working reload/shooting, intelligent zombie AI, increasing rounds, points economy, weapon purchasing, weapon upgrades (WAR FORGE), perk machines, interactive doors, multiple maps, boss encounters, complete HUD, game-over/restart. Minimum: 1 complete map, 5+ zombie types, 10+ firearms, round progression, points, purchasing, 1 boss.
- Xbox Gamepad support with CoD Zombies presets (Default, Tactical, Southpaw, Bumper Jumper, Legacy), rumble, hold-X-to-buy like console CoD.
- Build instruction: don't ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when finished.

content.text:
**CALL OF ZOMBIES: ROUND WAR is done and shipped to `index.html`** (105 KB, single self-contained file, zero dependencies — just open it in a browser).

## What was delivered

**Engine & gameplay**
- First-person raycasting shooter: WASD + mouse-look, sprint, crouch, tactical slide (sprint+C), ADS, hit-scan gunplay with per-weapon spread/recoil, grenades with physics bounce, knife melee, reloads, 2-slot weapon swap
- Procedural 3D-rendered everything: walls, weather (rain/fog/snow/red-alert flicker), sprite zombies with hit-flashes, view-model guns per weapon class, mystery box open/close animation, floating idol props

**Content**
- **4 maps** — Blackwater Military Base, Dead City, Operation Frostbite, The Underground — each with unique buy walls, perk placement,诛 doors, easter-egg idols, radio lore
- **22 weapons** (pistols through LMGs, snipers w/ pierce, FAMAS burst, AA-12, Ray Blaster AoE, Devastator GL projectile)
- **7 zombie types** + cycling bosses (Abomination/Warden/Devourer/Project Zero) with phases, summoning, telegraphed slams, unique health bar
- **8 perks** (4-slot limit), **WAR FORGE** 4-level weapon upgrades, mystery box (950 pts), wall ammo refills, hold-X-to-buy like console CoD, barricade repair for +10 pts
- Round progression, every-5th special events (FRENZY / GAS DRAG / BLACKOUT / NIGHTMARE), every-10th boss; 2 easter eggs per map (3 shootable idols → +4750 pts + Ray Blaster drop)
- Persistent profile (best rounds per zone, kills, rank), full HUD, minimap, pause/death/restart screens

**Xbox controller — full CoD Zombies presets**: Default, Tactical, Southpaw, Bumper Jumper, Legacy (fire on A), selectable in menus + mid-game, swap sticks for Southpaw, rumble on shots/damage/bosses, MENU pauses, LB/RB presets browsing, menu navigation with the pad.

## Assumptions I made
- **Solo only**: true online co-op needs a backend — not possible in one static HTML file. The architecture keeps players in an array so it's multiplayer-ready, but there is no netcode.
- **Stylized procedural art** instead of photoreal/UE5: no external assets are allowed in a single-file build, so visuals are canvas/WebAudio approximations (dynamic weather, muzzle flash, horror audio synth, dynamic music intensity).
- Windows: zombies spawn outside and claw boards off; you can't shoot through intact boards (matches CoD Zombies feel).

## Validation performed
- `node --check` syntax pass
- Map connectivity validator: all 4 maps **ALL PASSED** (every marker reachable, doors seal correctly, window spawns face walls)
- Headless runtime smoke tests with stubbed DOM/canvas/audio: 1500-frame play loop on every map, buy/perk/grenade/melee/reload/swap/pause exercised, direct-fire damage verified, egg hits verified, boss round verified, death→restart round-trip verified
- Three real bugs caught and fixed by the smoke tests: a `const` canvas context reassignment, the zombie `t` field collision (type overwritten by timer — killed all damage before this), and an invalid perk id `fire` that crashed perk machines
